name: Mixer Dynamic Cursor
author: Mixer Digital

sections.description:
Mixer Dynamic Cursor replaces the system pointer with an animated cursor that follows the mouse and reacts to what it hovers. Everything is set from one page in the dashboard, with a live preview.

22 cursor styles, each with one to three colours: Metaball, Dot, Glow, Comet, Trail, Crosshair, Magnet, Jelly, Lens, Pixel, Neon, Sparkles, Amoeba, Radar, Caret, Eclipse, Orbit, Brush, Autofocus, Glitch, Heart, Confetti. The cursor size goes from 50% to 500% of the original drawing.

Blend modes, named and grouped like in Photoshop: Normal, Darken, Multiply, Color Burn, Lighten, Screen, Color Dodge, Overlay, Soft Light, Hard Light, Negative, Difference, Exclusion, Hue, Saturation, Color, Luminosity. Negative turns any cursor white and shows the photographic negative of what it covers.

Three hover actions, each in three modes (Ring, Icon, Text) and with its own size (50–200%):

  • Button: buttons and links, tabs, ARIA interactive roles, form submit controls.
  • Carousel: Elementor (free and Pro), Swiper, Flickity, Slick, Owl, Splide, Glide, Tiny Slider, Keen, Embla, Smart Slider, MetaSlider, Soliloquy, Slider Revolution, and in general any container that scrolls horizontally. Carousels that cannot be dragged keep the normal cursor.
  • External link: links with target="_blank" or rel="external".

Other features

  • Optional system arrow: keep the computer arrow visible under the animated cursor, or hide it (default).
  • Icons from the media library (SVG or PNG with transparency). Without an icon, the bundled 45° arrow is used.
  • Font: the site font, a Google Font, or Adobe Fonts (Typekit project ID, validated from the dashboard).
  • Outline colour and width, text size, case and weight for the actions.
  • Extra CSS selectors for buttons, carousels and “system cursor” areas.
  • Per-element overrides: data-cursor="button|carousel|external|native" and data-cursor-text="Drag".
  • Mouse and trackpad only: on touch devices nothing is loaded. With “reduce motion” enabled, ambient animations and trails are turned off.
  • Not loaded in the Elementor editor and preview, in feeds, REST and AJAX requests.
  • A dynamic_cursor_should_load filter to switch the cursor off on specific pages.

External services

Mixer Dynamic Cursor works without contacting any external service. Two optional font sources, chosen by the administrator in the dashboard, load files from third-party servers:

Google Fonts — when “Google Fonts” is selected as the font source, every page of the site loads a stylesheet from fonts.googleapis.com and the font files from fonts.gstatic.com. Visitors’ browsers connect to Google servers, which receive their IP address. Service: Google Fonts — Google Privacy Policy — Google Fonts FAQ on privacy.

Adobe Fonts (Typekit) — when “Adobe Fonts” is selected, every page of the site loads a stylesheet from use.typekit.net with the project ID you entered, and visitors’ browsers connect to Adobe servers. In addition, when the administrator clicks “Validate ID” in the dashboard, the site’s server fetches https://use.typekit.net/<project-id>.css once to read the available font families. No other data is sent. Service: Adobe Fonts — Adobe Terms of Use — Adobe Privacy Policy.

With the default “Site font” option, no external request is made.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the mixer-dynamic-cursor folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install it from Plugins → Add New.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Open the Mixer Dynamic Cursor menu in the dashboard, choose a style, colours and actions, and save.
sections.faq:
The cursor does not appear on my site

The cursor only works with a mouse or trackpad: on touch screens the system pointer is kept. Check that the switch at the top of the Mixer Dynamic Cursor page is on, and that you are not in the Elementor editor or preview.

How do I keep the normal cursor on a specific element?

Add data-cursor="native" to the element, or add its CSS selector under Advanced → System cursor on.

My carousel is not recognised

Add the carousel’s CSS selector under Advanced → More carousels, or data-cursor="carousel" on its container. A custom word can be set with data-cursor-text="…" on the carousel or on any ancestor.

Can I turn the cursor off on some pages?

Yes, with the dynamic_cursor_should_load filter:

add_filter( 'dynamic_cursor_should_load', function ( $load ) { return ! is_page( 'contact' ) && $load; } );

Is the plugin available in my language?

The interface is in English and can be translated on translate.wordpress.org. Approved translations are installed automatically by WordPress. An Italian translation is already submitted for review.

Does the plugin send data anywhere?

No. Only the optional Google Fonts and Adobe Fonts sources load files from their servers; see External services above.
sections.changelog:
1.9.2

  • Hardening: font family names keep only letters, digits, spaces and hyphens, so a stray quote can no longer break the cursor font.
  • Cleaner logo file (no editor metadata).

1.9.1

  • With “Show the system arrow” on, the arrow now hides wherever the cursor shows a text (buttons, carousels, external links in Text mode), so the word reads clearly. Everywhere else it stays visible.

1.9.0

  • New “Show the system arrow” switch: the computer arrow can stay visible under the animated cursor. Off by default, so existing sites do not change.

1.8.0

  • New “Negative” blend mode: any cursor turns white and inverts what it covers. It replaces the Invert type: sites that used Invert switch automatically to a large Dot in Negative, with the same look.
  • Cursor size: 50–500% of the drawing, for every style.
  • Size of each action (Button, Carousel, External link): 50–200% of the ring or disc.
  • Removed the Beam type; sites that used it switch to Crosshair.
  • Fixed: “Validate ID” for Adobe Fonts called the wrong AJAX action and never validated.

1.7.1

  • Renamed to Mixer Dynamic Cursor (slug mixer-dynamic-cursor) for the WordPress.org directory. Translations now come from translate.wordpress.org; the bundled language files and load_plugin_textdomain() were removed.
  • Dashboard below 1100px wide (single column): the preview no longer stays stuck over the settings while scrolling; tighter card padding on phones.

1.7.0

  • Ready for the WordPress.org directory: unique dynamic_cursor_ prefix on functions, constants, option and hooks (the settings saved by earlier versions are migrated automatically), English interface, uninstall routine, documented external services.
  • Lifecycle notice moved to Tools → Site Health only.
  • JS globals renamed to DynamicCursorConfig and DynamicCursorAdmin.

1.6.2

  • Dashboard logo in a single colour.

1.6.1

  • Lifecycle check: “Tested up to” and “Support until” headers compared with the site, with a notice in Site Health.

1.6.0

  • Overlays and widgets above the page (e.g. accessibility panels): the cursor stays visible above them, also inside shadow DOM.
  • Outline of ring and disc: colour and width of your choice (0 = none).
  • Text size per action in Text mode (10–40 px).
  • Carousels that cannot be dragged keep the normal cursor; data-cursor="carousel" forces it.
  • Action text: case and weight options, normal letter spacing.

Older versions: see changelog.txt in the plugin folder.
